verdict.rationale: Synctera exposes a 'scheduled payments' API to create and manage recurring payment schedules, which is the only evidence of any recurring/scheduled execution capability. There is no evidence of a general-purpose job/workflow scheduler, cron-like automation, or orchestration engine that an AI-native user could use to schedule arbitrary recurring workflows beyond payments. Missing for 10: general recurring workflow/job scheduling API, agent/automation orchestration support, and independent confirmation of scheduling reliability.
